title: GnaniAgentPlan
description: The structured JSON plan that Gnani Evon must return for the Agent to process

goal.description: A human-readable description of what the user wants to achieve

requires_confirmation.description: Whether the overall plan requires user confirmation before execution

steps.description: The ordered list of tool calls to execute

tool.description: The tool name from the Tool Registry (e.g. crm.find_order)

parameters.description: Parameters to pass to the tool. Can reference prior step outputs using {{step_N.field}} syntax

depends_on.description: List of step IDs this step depends on (for sequential ordering)

description.description: Human-readable description of what this step does

trigger.description: Canonical workflow trigger; required for AUTOMATE mode

automation_config.description: Only present when mode is AUTOMATE

trigger_config.description: Trigger-specific configuration (cron for schedule, event name for event, etc.)

clarification_needed.description: True if Evon could not fully plan due to missing information

clarification_question.description: If clarification_needed is true, the question to ask the user

examples.goal: Create high-priority tickets for all delayed orders and notify logistics on Slack

steps.description: Find orders delayed more than 2 days

parameters.title: Order Delayed
parameters.description: Order has been delayed by {{step_1.orders[*].delay_days}} days

steps.description: Create a high-priority ticket for each delayed order

parameters.message: Alert: {{step_1.count}} orders are delayed. Tickets created. Please review.

examples.goal: Whenever an order is delayed by more than 2 days, create a ticket and notify logistics

parameters.title: Order Delayed Alert
parameters.description: Automated: Order delayed more than 2 days
